02Not a press release

Still a student.
Already building.

I’m studying Electronics & Communication Engineering with a VLSI specialization at VIT Chennai. I founded and captain the Chip Designers Guild, where students work on RTL, verification, FPGA prototyping and ASIC projects.

I’m also an R&D intern at Sentrix Robotics, working on tactile and environmental sensing for Physical AI, and I’m building semiconductor flow tooling through TapeItOut. My portfolio is a workbench, not a victory lap: architecture, simulation evidence and unfinished work are labeled separately.
